general.descripcion_cabecera: Check the status and progress of your requests when an authorised source is available.
general.estado_vacio: There are no requests in this list
general.detalle_no_configurado: The authorised source for your requests has not been connected.
general.detalle_denegado: The source has not authorised access. Request access through the appropriate channel.
general.detalle_error: The source did not respond. Open this section again later.
general.detalle_vacio: The source returned no requests for this query.
general.ayuda_estado: Only data returned by the authorised source is shown. A status or alert does not confirm official notification.
general.bandeja_subtitulo: Select a reference to view the request and its progress.
general.nueva_subtitulo: The catalogue comes from the source for each request type.
general.nueva_ayuda: Each type needs its own procedure, authorisation, registration and receipt. This view does not start requests.
general.iniciar_motivo: The procedure, registration and receipt still need to be connected.
general.seguimiento_vacio: Select a request from the list to view its details.
general.seguimiento_ayuda: Milestones come from the source. Without a returned history, this view cannot confirm any actions.
general.historial_vacio: The source returned no milestones for this request.
general.aportar_motivo: The document repository, authorisation, registration and receipt are pending.
general.certificados_subtitulo: View the retrieved catalogue. This view does not create or download documents.
general.certificados_ayuda: A certificate type in the catalogue does not confirm that an issued or signed document exists.
general.emitir_motivo: Issuing, signing, custody and authorised download are pending.
